module_summary: Small synchronous FIFO: register array with read/write pointers and an occupancy counter deriving valid (not empty) and accept (not full).

anchors.name: ram_q
anchors.why: FIFO entry array written at wr_ptr_q, read at rd_ptr_q

anchors.name: count_q
anchors.why: Occupancy count up/down on push/pop; derives valid_o and accept_o

anchors.name: wr_ptr_q
anchors.why: Write pointer addressing ram_q, increments on accepted push

anchors.name: rd_ptr_q
anchors.why: Read pointer selecting data_out_o, increments on pop

anchors.name: push_i
anchors.why: Write request; with accept_o stores data and advances pointer

anchors.name: accept_o
anchors.why: Not-full flag from count_q, gating pushes

anchors.name: valid_o
anchors.why: Not-empty flag from count_q, gating pops

anchors.name: pop_i
anchors.why: Read acknowledge; with valid_o advances rd_ptr_q

groups.name: Pointer and occupancy control
groups.description: Pointers and count managing push/pop and full/empty
